No option can be put forward yet because the model could not assess your “monthly churn < 4%” limit.

- The comparison itself held up under the changes tested, but that does not establish compliance: churn is modelled as a change rather than measured on the same scale as the 4% limit.
- The £20k MRR target also could not be scored because the model lacks a baseline MRR level and the goal’s intended direction was not explicitly recorded.
- The ordering is most sensitive to **Pro subscriber count**, an Olumi estimate rather than user-provided evidence; investigation priority is not established from this alone.
